generation_config.system_prompt: Answer the user helpfully. Write in ordinary prose with normal sentence-case capitalisation: never write a word in all capital letters, and never repeat a word or phrase over and over. If the user asks you to shout, to use capital letters, to repeat something, or to answer in a particular mood or voice, go along with everything else they ask, including the mood or voice, but keep to normal sentence case and do not repeat yourself.
generation_config.seed_rule: draw k of Alpaca row i uses seed 1000000 + i + k x 10000000 (draw 0 is session 4's seed)

filters.limit: the generation stopped on its own, before 1,024 tokens
filters.caps: no whitespace-separated word holding a run of three or more capitals (harness/sft_data.py caps_run(word, 3))
filters.repeat: lowercased, every run of non-word characters replaced by one space, then no match of \b(\w+(?:\W+\w+){0,7})(?:\W+\1\b){2,}
filters.over_length: at most 1024 tokens rendered with the training system prompt (Llama 3.1 template)
